aboutText: All Tech Bathrooms, based in Diamond Creek, provides fully licensed trades under one roof for hassle-free bathroom renovations. We focus on one project at a time, ensuring exclusive attention from start to finish without delays. Our services range from classic old-world glamour to modern state-of-the-art remodelling, tailored to your taste.
servicesText: At All Tech Bathrooms, we provide end-to-end bathroom services from initial design to final touches. Our licensed trades cover tiling, waterproofing, plumbing, electrical work, and custom renovations, all tailored to your specific needs and style.

services.title: Bathroom Renovation
services.desc: Complete bathroom renovation service from concept to completion, handling all aspects including demolition, tiling, and fixture installation.

services.title: Custom Tiling
services.desc: Specialised tiling services for bathrooms, including floor and wall tiles, with expert craftsmanship and a variety of design options.

services.title: Waterproofing
services.desc: Professional waterproofing application to ensure your bathroom is fully sealed and protected against water ingress and damage.

services.title: Plumbing Services
services.desc: Licensed plumbing services for bathroom fixtures, including sinks, toilets, showers, and pipes, installed and repaired with precision.

services.title: Electrical Work
services.desc: Qualified electrical work for bathroom lighting, exhaust fans, and other electrical components, ensuring safety and compliance.

services.title: Design Consultation
services.desc: Tailored design consultations to help you visualise and plan your perfect bathroom, from layout to material selection.
